notes: 10 ¶ Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise [and] praise thee? Selah.

This psalm was perhaps composed on the occasion of Absalom's rebellion, 2 Sam. 15; or of the revolt of the ten tribes, from their subjection to the family of David, 1 Kings 12; or it relates to the Chaldean oppression and captivity, 2 Kings 24-25.
